json-decode-unchecked-variants-and-range.note: json@1 decoding accepts a string that isn't one of the enum's variants, and an integer outside its type's range; the reference refuses both

json-decode-unchecked-shape.note: json@1 decoding accepts the wrong JSON kind, a missing or repeated struct field, an integer spelled 1.0, 1e0 or -0, and a float past its range; the reference refuses them

json-encode-f32-digits.note: json@1 writes an f32 with the shortest digits of a double (1.401298464324817e-45), the reference with those of the f32 (1e-45): the same f32, not the same JSON number

jsonrpc-decode-lenient.note: jsonrpc@1 decoding accepts a declared member twice, and an id or error code spelled 1.0, 1e0 or -0; the reference refuses both

reference-jsonrpc-method-escapes.note: the reference refuses a JSON-RPC method name written with any escape, and writes a name that needs one unescaped; TypeScript escapes, and reads any spelling

reference-jsonrpc-ignored-members-unvali.note: the reference accepts invalid UTF-8 inside JSON-RPC members it ignores (jsonrpc, error.message, undeclared ones); TypeScript refuses any frame that isn't UTF-8

connection-replies-in-any-order.note: Connection hands a reply to the call it answers in any order; an ordered (nested, blocking) Rust State refuses a reply that skips the innermost waiting call as a framing error. TypeScript has only the async model
